copy.note: A hundred pages, in story order, from the snake sacrifice to the last refusal. The long counsel after the war is not retold page for page. On the chariot, the Gita is the turn, not the whole recitation.
copy.doneBody: The story stops where Yudhishthira refuses a heaven without his own people. It does not return to the start.

story.gateBody: {from} ends here. {to} is next, when you are ready.
